summary: The parser incorrectly consumes trailing space after a local date as a date/time separator, rejecting valid input such as `foo = 1979-05-27 # Comment`. The fix checks for an hour after the separator and backtracks when absent, allowing the space and comment to be parsed normally. The fix adds this regression case to parser::tests::documents. Both reversal regions occur exactly once; replacing the fixed region restores the parent implementation file exactly. No tests were run.
